description: This Dart file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages user authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles login, registration, logout, and token persistence with shared preferences, as well as interaction with an API service.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages user authentication state, token management, and API interactions related to authentication.

methods.name: _loadToken
methods.description: Loads the authentication token from shared preferences and updates the API service.

methods.name: _saveToken
methods.description: Saves or removes the authentication token in shared preferences.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login via the API, stores the token, and updates the auth state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user via the API, and if token is returned, saves and updates auth state; otherwise attempts login.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token and updates the auth state.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state for authentication processes.
